acceptanceCriteria: The MCP preview Markdown and report metadata match the published CLI report for the same immutable CEM inputs.
The preview remains read-only, bounded, and preserves refusal/uncertainty; focused parity and hostile tests pass.
Retain observed CI reproduction, focused checks, independent review, and required integration result.
body:
Confirmed regression at integration23799bb63832470014b96a4be57a7e564a335e76. GitHub CI36713890494 job109882451752 fails internal/mcp/bridge TestCEMReportToolPreviewsCLIReportWithoutPublishing attools_test.go:101. Local GOTOOLCHAIN=local Go1.27.1 focused reproduction FAIL1.607s. Published report appends new review projection while ActionReportPreview renders only renderReportText. Expected byte-identical readonly preview under existing MCPV0-025; actual mismatch. Logs /private/tmp/corvint-wow-manager/merge-ci-product-0.log andmcp-preview-baseline.log. Existing source Corvintcontext READY with retained14omittedresults and affectedLANGUAGE_FRONTIER unknowns. Fix restoring original parity contract is needed for owner-requested PR385 merge.

Additional confirmed CI repair friction: run 36723447579 at e3ff3b72 passed every shard0 test, then failed test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal tools)" before vet and Windows compilation. Exact gofmt -d showed only map-field whitespace at internal/cem/workflow/read.go:130 introduced by this preview repair. Expected canonical gofmt spacing; actual extra field alignment. Mechanical commit d7749792 applies that one normalization. Full formatting audit, go vet ./... and CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./... exited0; readonly module-stat cache warning retained in the Windows log. Required CI rerun 36726094223 remains pending/running, so no merge or completion is yet claimed. Evidence: merge-final-ci-shard0.log, merge-final-full-vet.log, merge-final-windows-build.log in the manager directory.
title: Repair readonly MCP CEM report preview parity after proof review projection
